label: Bitvavo
terms_note: Public market data only. Rate limit: 1000 weight points per minute per IP for unauthenticated calls, and exceeding it blocks the IP for 15 minutes (https://docs.bitvavo.com/docs/rate-limits/), so the server stays at 2 requests per second. Docs vs live (2026-09-27): GET /v2/markets answers every market in one array, in no documented order and without paging; numbers are strings and may use exponent notation ("high": "7.479E+4"); an unknown market answers HTTP 400 {errorCode: 205, error: "market parameter is invalid."}.

list_markets.note: GET /v2/markets returns every market (BTC-EUR, ETH-USDC, ...) in one answer: the server filters by `query` (substring of the market, base or quote, case-insensitive), sorts by symbol and pages locally; the list is fetched once per minute at most. raw has status (trading, halted, auction, ...), order limits, tickSize and orderTypes.

get_ticker.note: symbol is a market from list_markets, e.g. BTC-EUR. 24-hour ticker: last trade price, best bid/ask and the base-currency volume of the last 24 hours; raw has open/high/low, bidSize/askSize and volumeQuote.

get_candles.note: interval is one of 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 6h, 8h, 12h, 1d, 1W, 1M (the documented values); returns the latest `limit` candles, newest first, as documented. time is the candle start in UTC.

not_offered.me: Account endpoints need an API key and an HMAC-SHA256 Bitvavo-Access-Signature (https://docs.bitvavo.com/docs/rest-api/introduction/); this entry serves the public market data only.
not_offered.get_balances: GET /v2/balance requires the Bitvavo-Access-Key / Bitvavo-Access-Signature headers (https://docs.bitvavo.com/docs/rest-api/get-account-balance/); public-data entry only.
not_offered.list_orders: GET /v2/ordersOpen requires authentication (https://docs.bitvavo.com/docs/rest-api/get-open-orders/); public-data entry only.
not_offered.place_order: POST /v2/order requires authentication and spends money (https://docs.bitvavo.com/docs/rest-api/create-order/); not mapped in this public-data entry.
not_offered.cancel_order: DELETE /v2/order requires authentication (https://docs.bitvavo.com/docs/rest-api/cancel-order/); not mapped in this public-data entry.
